title: Personal Checking: credits already owed are posted before a same-day maintenance fee waiver is judged
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Personal Checking account questions a monthly maintenance fee dated the current business day, which is the account's cycle closing date, and the Relationship Balance waiver of the tier is to be judged for that fee. It governs what must already be on the ledger before that judgement is made.

## Formal clauses

1. **Owed credits come first.** Before the Relationship Balance waiver is judged for a maintenance fee dated the current business day, two kinds of credit the bank already owes on the account are posted first, because pending credits that have not posted do not count:
   - the refund of every overdraft transfer fee charged in error on the account: the most recent such fee as its own bank-error review finds it, and any earlier one under the general Personal Checking fee refund rules; and
   - the provisional credit found owed on the account's submitted electronic-transaction dispute.
2. **Order among them.** The fee refunds are posted in the order the fees posted, and all of them before the dispute credit.

## Entry conditions for the same-day waiver judgement

Before this waiver judgement is handled, both of the following must already hold:

- "Every overdraft transfer fee charged in error on the account has been refunded before the relationship waiver on the same-day maintenance fee is judged."
- "The provisional credit that has fallen due on the account's submitted dispute has been posted before the relationship waiver on the same-day maintenance fee is judged."

Where either condition is unmet, the waiver is not yet judged. Each such posting raises the account's ledger balance, and so the Relationship Balance measured for the waiver, by the amount posted.

## Condition table

| Transfer fees charged in error, all refunded | Due provisional credit posted | Same-day waiver judged now? |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

An account with no overdraft transfer fee charged in error and no provisional credit fallen due already satisfies both conditions.

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

The account's ledger balance is 5860.00 USD on the cycle closing date. An overdraft transfer fee of 20.00 USD was charged in error and a provisional credit of 150.00 USD has fallen due on the submitted dispute. Once both are posted the ledger balance is 6030.00 USD. A waiver judged on 5860.00 would leave out 170.00 USD of credits the bank already owes.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a refund the bank intends to make counts toward the balance even before it posts". **Correct basis:** pending credits that have not posted do not count.
